Hi Everyone,
We had an interview for A5 in April this year while I still have my B1 valid until July 14( it was extended for 3 months because of war), After the interview I left the country for over a month. During this time MH called to ask us when am I entering the country. Now I am back and they called again and told us that they are sending us to a committee. My visa is about to expire and they didn’t share any dates. What does it mean that they are sending us to a committee? Thanks for the help.
